transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?
I'm here because I've been hearing and seeing things that other people can't, and it's been going on for over two years now. On top of that, I've
Can you tell me more about your mood over the past two years, have you experienced any periods of extreme highs or lows, or persistent feelings of sadness?

My mood has been all over the place for the last two years and four months. I'll go through periods of about three months where I feel incredibly high, full of energy, and just can't stop talking. But then I'll crash into deep sadness and emptiness for about two months, where I lose interest in absolutely everything.
Do the periods of hearing and seeing things that others can't seem to happen at the same time as your highs and lows, or do they occur independently of your mood swings?

It is actually both. I definitely experience those hallucinations when my energy is super high, but I've also had them completely on their own for at least two weeks when my mood felt totally normal and stable.
For how much of the past two years would you say the hallucinations or delusions were present, compared to the periods of extreme mood swings?

The extreme mood swings, especially those intense highs, have been there for most of the past two-plus years. The hallucinations and delusions only happened on their own, when my mood was completely normal, for about two to three weeks. Most of the time, the symptoms seem to overlap with my highs.
Can you estimate what percentage of the time over the past two years you've experienced hallucinations or delusions when you weren't in a high or low mood episode?

It was a very small percentage, probably only about one or two percent of the entire time. Out of the whole two years and four months, that period where I had hallucinations with a completely stable mood only lasted for about two weeks. The rest of the time, they were always tied to my mood swings.

Did you experience any significant periods of time where you had hallucinations or delusions without any accompanying mood swings, lasting for at least two weeks, but not necessarily the full two years and four months?

Yes, absolutely. There was definitely a period of about two weeks where I was hearing and seeing things constantly, but my mood was completely normal and stable. I didn't feel manic or depressed at all during those weeks.

Can you tell me more about what was going through your mind during those two weeks when you had hallucinations but a stable mood, were the hallucinations organized and part of a coherent theme or were they more disorganized and fragmented?

I'm not really sure how to categorize them, and I haven't really thought about them in terms of being organized or fragmented. All I know is that they felt incredibly real and were very confusing to experience at the time.
Were the hallucinations during that two-week period related to a specific theme, such as persecution, grandiosity, or something else, or were they more random and unrelated to each other?

During those two weeks, they definitely felt connected to a specific theme. I kept hearing voices whispering that people were plotting against me and watching my every move, and I truly believed I was being targeted. It wasn't just random sounds; it felt like a very specific, frightening plan was unfolding around me.
How have these experiences, both the mood swings and the hallucinations, affected your daily life, relationships, and ability to work or engage in activities you enjoy?

These experiences have completely derailed my life, and I've lost all motivation to work or even do basic daily tasks. I no longer find any pleasure in the hobbies I used to love, and I've completely withdrawn from my friends and family because I feel so disconnected from everyone. It just feels impossible to interact with people or care about anything anymore.

Have you ever experienced a period of at least two weeks where you had hallucinations or delusions without any significant mood symptoms, such as depression or mania, and if so, how did that period compare to your overall experience of hallucinations and delusions over the past two years?

Yes, I definitely had a period of about two weeks where I experienced those frightening voices and beliefs of being watched, without any highs or lows at all. During those weeks, my mood felt completely flat and normal, but the hallucinations and delusions were just as intense and real as they are during my manic or depressive phases. It showed me that these experiences can happen completely on their own, even when my emotions aren't running wild.
